description: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) for .NET: a deterministic canonical form for any JSON value and a SHA-256 content fingerprint, NativeAOT-ready.
rules: Use JsonCanonicalizer.Canonicalize / CanonicalizeToUtf8 / Hash; they accept a JsonElement, a JSON string, UTF-8 bytes, a JsonNode, or a value with its JsonTypeInfo<T>.
Hash returns the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical form: sign or HMAC CanonicalizeToUtf8, never the output of JsonSerializer directly.
Input with no canonical form (duplicate member names, numbers outside the double range, lone surrogates) throws FormatException; invalid JSON text throws JsonException.
For NativeAOT, serialize typed values through a source-generated JsonSerializerContext (JsonTypeInfo<T>) overload.
